description: This Java class implements a Netty channel handler for managing WebSocket connections in the MockServer project, specifically handling callback WebSocket server logic including upgrade, message handling, and exception management.

classes.name: CallbackWebSocketServerHandler
classes.description: A Netty channel handler for managing WebSocket callback connections, including upgrade, message processing, and cleanup.

methods.name: CallbackWebSocketServerHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing WebSocket client registry and logger from HttpState.

methods.name: channelRead
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, performing WebSocket upgrade or message processing based on message type.

methods.name: channelReadComplete
methods.description: Flushes the channel after read completion.

methods.name: upgradeChannel
methods.description: Performs WebSocket handshake and registers client, removing unnecessary pipeline handlers.

methods.name: handleWebSocketFrame
methods.description: Processes WebSocket frames: close, text, ping, or throws exception for unsupported types.

methods.name: exceptionCaught
methods.description: Logs exception if connection is closed and closes the channel.
